headline: Chris Hadfield
signed Osiris.
lede: At the range in Timmins, Chris Hadfield stopped by to meet the team and signed the nosecone before our highest flight ever.

photos.alt: Chris Hadfield in aviator sunglasses and a grey polo, surrounded by McMaster Rocketry team members at the Launch Canada range.
photos.caption: Chris Hadfield meets the team at the range.

photos.alt: Chris Hadfield leans over Osiris's white nosecone on a truck tailgate and signs it with a black marker.
photos.caption: Signing the nosecone on the tailgate.

photos.alt: Osiris's white nosecone with Chris Hadfield's signature in black marker, resting on a truck tailgate.
photos.caption: The signed nosecone before integration.

photos.alt: Close-up of Chris Hadfield's signature on the recovered nosecone, white paint chipped away from drag on the way down.
photos.caption: The signed nosecone after recovery. Chipped paint from drag.
